risks.description: No heat treatment, case depth, or hardness is specified. The ring is quoted soft. If carburising is in scope, this route and this price do not include it.
risks.mitigation: Confirm whether heat treatment is in scope. If it is, add carburise, quench and temper plus the post-HT finishing the hardened sizes require.

feasibility.assessment_notes: Bought-in forged ring, finished overall height 53.8 mm, quoted soft. No heat treatment is specified, so none is routed or priced. The internal spur teeth are shaped after the minor diameter is turned. Internal shaving is not required at Ra 3.2. The blank fits the part: Ø213 / Ø175 × 58 mm contains Ø208 × 53.8 mm.
